title: Admin - Comment Moderation - Filter by Content Type - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Comment Moderation - Filter by Content Type feature on the Y4J platform. This feature provides a content type filter with options (All Types, Queries, Reviews, Vendor Responses) that shows only matching content when selected. The type tag is clearly displayed on each moderation card. Covers filter options, dynamic filtering, type tag display, and integration with other filters.

testCases.title: Content type filter is visible with correct options
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Comment Moderation page is loaded.
steps: Locate the content type filter control
Click/open the filter to see available options
expectedResults: A content type filter control is visible on the page
The filter shows four options: 'All Types', 'Queries', 'Reviews', 'Vendor Responses'
All options are selectable
The default selection is 'All Types'
testCases.postconditions: Content type filter is confirmed visible with correct options

testCases.title: Selecting 'All Types' shows all content
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Items of different content types exist.
steps: Select 'All Types' from the content type filter
expectedResults: All moderation items are displayed regardless of content type
Queries, Reviews, and Vendor Responses are all visible
The list is unfiltered by type
The count reflects the total number of items

testCases.title: Selecting 'Queries' shows only query items
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Query-type moderation items exist.
steps: Select 'Queries' from the content type filter
expectedResults: Only items with 'Query' content type are displayed
No 'Review' or 'Vendor Response' items are shown
Each visible card shows a 'Query' type tag
The list updates dynamically without page reload

testCases.title: Selecting 'Reviews' shows only review items
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Review-type moderation items exist.
steps: Select 'Reviews' from the content type filter
expectedResults: Only items with 'Review' content type are displayed
No 'Query' or 'Vendor Response' items are shown
Each visible card shows a 'Review' type tag
The list updates dynamically

testCases.title: Selecting 'Vendor Responses' shows only vendor response items
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Vendor Response-type moderation items exist.
steps: Select 'Vendor Responses' from the content type filter
expectedResults: Only items with 'Vendor Response' content type are displayed
No 'Query' or 'Review' items are shown
Each visible card shows a 'Vendor Response' type tag
The list updates dynamically
testCases.postconditions: Only vendor response items are visible

testCases.title: Type tag is clearly displayed on each moderation card
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items of different types exist.
steps: Verify each card has a visible type tag
expectedResults: Each moderation card displays a content type tag
The tag shows 'Query', 'Review', or 'Vendor Response'
The tag is visually distinct (badge, colored label, or tag element)
The tag is clearly readable and not obscured
testCases.postconditions: Type tags are confirmed visible on all cards

testCases.title: Filter updates list immediately on selection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items exist.
expectedResults: The list updates immediately after selection
No page reload occurs
The transition is smooth
The selected filter is visually indicated

testCases.title: Type filter works with status filter combined
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Items with various types and statuses exist.
steps: Select 'Reviews' from the content type filter
expectedResults: Results are filtered by BOTH status AND content type
Only items that are 'Pending' AND 'Review' type are shown
Both filters are applied simultaneously
Neither filter overrides the other

testCases.title: Type filter works with search combined
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Items exist.
steps: Type a search query in the search field
expectedResults: Results are filtered by BOTH the type filter AND the search query
Only query-type items matching the search are shown
The search respects the type filter
Combined filtering works correctly

testCases.title: Empty results for selected type shows empty state
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. A type filter + other filter combination yields no results.
steps: Apply filters that yield no results (e.g., type + status + search with no match)
expectedResults: No moderation cards are displayed
An empty state message is shown (e.g., 'No results found')
The filter selections remain active
The user can change filters to see results

testCases.title: Switching between type filters updates correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Items of all types exist.
expectedResults: Each switch updates the list immediately
Results are different for each type (assuming items of each type exist)
Switching to 'All Types' restores the full list
No stale data remains from previous filter

testCases.title: Type tags are visually distinguishable from each other
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Items of different types exist.
steps: Navigate to Comment Moderation page with 'All Types' selected
Observe cards with different type tags
expectedResults: 'Query', 'Review', and 'Vendor Response' tags are visually different
An admin can quickly distinguish between types at a glance
Tags may use different colors, icons, or styles
The distinction does not rely solely on color (text is different)
